data.narrative:
Singularity, a Series A-stage Defense & Security company led by Jack Oswald and Shail Giroux, is valued at $400M post-money following $82M in total fundraising. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of nine same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies, supplemented by two public defense technology peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). The private peer set ranges from $125M to $3.0B in valuation, with a median of $1.0B. Sampled peers include Dream Security ($3.0B Series B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B Series B), Code Metal ($1.2B Series B), and Castelion and Defense Unicorns (both $1.0B Series B).

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-progression anchors to the current $400M post-money valuation and applies a typical 2.0x Series A-to-next-stage multiplier, yielding $800M. Peer-median comparison across nine Defense & Security companies at comparable maturity stages implies $1.0B, consistent with the broader private comp range.

Integrating both methods produces a valuation range of $680M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a triangulated median of $900M. The current $400M valuation sits meaningfully below this range, suggesting 80-175% upside under comparable transactions. Key uncertainty centers on near-term capital deployment and customer concentration in what remains an early-stage portfolio company.
